name: What's the difference between a built-in BBQ and a freestanding grill?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a built-in BBQ and a freestanding grill?

acceptedAnswer.text: A built-in BBQ is permanently integrated into an outdoor kitchen island or custom structure, becoming a fixed part of your outdoor living space. It typically requires professional installation for utility connections and custom enclosure construction. In contrast, a freestanding grill is a self-contained, portable unit that can be moved. Built-in units offer a more custom, aesthetic, and often more robust outdoor cooking experience, while freestanding grills prioritize flexibility and simpler setup.
acceptedAnswer.description: A built-in BBQ is permanently integrated into an outdoor kitchen, while a freestanding grill is a portable, self-contained unit. Built-ins offer a custom aesthetic; freestanding offers flexibility.
